overview_description.description: Udrive is the first pay-per-minute car sharing provider in the Middle East which offers car rental through mobile access on the street. Udrive is a Dubai-based mobility platform offering on-demand car sharing and rental services through a smartphone app. Founded in 2016, it enables users to rent vehicles by the minute, hour, day, or month across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Udrive focuses on convenient urban mobility, integrating digital payments, flexible rentals, fuel, parking, and insurance into a seamless app-based transportation experience.

about_short_description.short_description: Udrive is a car-sharing platform enabling users to rent vehicles instantly via mobile app for flexible, short-term use.

product.name: Udrive Pay-Per-Minute Car Sharing Service
product.description: A mobile app-based car rental service allowing users to locate, unlock, and rent cars by the minute within designated city zones.

product.name: Udrive Long-Term Car Rental
product.description: A subscription-based car rental option allowing users to rent vehicles for extended periods, from monthly up to 12 months.

product.name: Udrive Mobile Application
product.description: A smartphone app that facilitates locating, unlocking, and managing car rentals within Udrive's fleet.

product.name: Insurance Coverage Options
product.description: Basic insurance included with rentals, with optional upgrades to Collision Damage Waiver or Full Damage Coverage for additional protection.

product.name: Fuel and Parking Services
product.description: Provision of free fuel and parking at designated stations and zones within operational cities for Udrive vehicles.
